description: Stage 6e per-phase measurement of native TFOLD open path, residency comparison, and three-way logits SHA verification

phase_breakdown_native.notes: FNV cost dominates by three orders of magnitude; everything else is in the microsecond range. The DONTNEED call (drop_pages) is ~16 ms even though it covers the whole 3.4 GB mapping.

stage6d_vs_stage6e_native.interpretation: Stage 6e added madvise(DONTNEED) after FNV verification. It reclaimed 1.5 GB of RSS (native now at parity with safetensors) but added ~0.6 s wall because the Qwen loader re-faults pages from the page cache during cudaMemcpy. The trade is acceptable: process RSS now matches the materialized/safetensors paths, important for coexistence with the CUDA driver's reserved VRAM carveout on GB10.

fnv_optimization_evidence.cross_check_test: zig/src/core/tfold_file_test.zig::fnv1a64_unrolled bit-identical to scalar reference over random 16 MB
fnv_optimization_evidence.notes: The unrolled variant reduces loop overhead but the multiply-chain latency still dominates (~3 cycles/byte). ReleaseFast gets ~1 GB/s single-core; adopting the unrolled form at ReleaseFast/ReleaseSafe does not harm throughput and makes a measurable but small improvement in loop overhead. Adopted as default in Release builds; scalar kept as the Debug reference so stack traces are clean.

format_defaults.delta_breakdown: FNV scan of body (3.40 s) + DONTNEED (0.016 s) + header parse (0.001 s) + mmap (0.000 s) = 3.42 s added to Stage 6d's 2.72 s inference cost.

equivalent_verification_work.note: Measured safetensors-with-matched-FNV-scan is not implemented as a one-click command in tf-qwen35-cuda (would require a CLI flag that adds a forced FNV scan before loading). Deferred to a follow-up CLI flag. The honest claim remains: the 1.73 s delta IS the integrity cost that TFOLD pays and safetensors does not.

test_checkpoint_io_host_debug.notes: Includes 12 Stage 6d structural tests + 3 Stage 6e FNV tests (unrolled bit-identity, tail edge cases, throughput floor)

verdict: PASS - residency parity achieved via DONTNEED, FNV unroll adopted with cross-check test, wall-time cost of integrity measured and documented, three-way SHA match preserved
